errors.what: first firmware fix stopped the drive on a lost pot reading, which reset the stall timer every other tick so a jammed actuator never faulted (no capacitor, readings locked to a PWM edge)
errors.fix: found by the new tests/pot_pickup_sweep.py before commit; lost ticks now hold the last duty and count toward the stall time; regression test added

errors.what: first jam test ran at full duty, where sign-magnitude PWM has no edges, so it could not show pickup
errors.fix: jam moved 3 mm short of the goal, where the loop runs at min duty

errors.what: post seo_title 90 chars and description 186 chars, over the 70/160 limits

doc_friction.issue: suggested 'twist the motor pair' against the pot's PWM noise; with sign-magnitude drive only one wire toggles, so twisting does not cancel the electric field at the wiper
